title: Classic BGM
description: Minecraft background music will no longer make you sad. Classical music will soothe your soul.
body:
Minecraft background music will no longer make you sad. Classical music will soothe your soul.

Minecraft's background music is great, but if you play alone like me, it can often feel lonely. This resource pack brings together famous classical pieces to create new Minecraft background music that's sure to soothe your soul.
